assertions.name: version_2
assertions.sql: SELECT version FROM myapp.workers_current WHERE worker_id = {target_worker}

assertions.name: new_title
assertions.sql: SELECT job_profile FROM myapp.workers_current WHERE worker_id = {target_worker}

assertions.name: one_history_row
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM myapp.workers_history WHERE worker_id = {target_worker}

assertions.name: history_keeps_old_title
assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM myapp.workers_history WHERE worker_id = {target_worker} AND job_profile <> 'Senior Engineer'

description: Title + salary change versions the worker; the old title is retained in history.
name: SCD4: promotion changes title and salary
